I did not get your question. Anyway, this implementation is according to the schema and for whatever reason, the schema is already defined in this way.
So this assumes DedicatedNetworkPort maps to Ethernet ? Is there anything in Redfish that backs this up?
The implementation as per redfish schema mentioned in the commit log. The validation test passed. Are you looking for something else?

Yeah, I am trying to understand if the mapping is correct. Please add some of that to the commit msg. 

In PDI / networkd, EmitLLDP is on the Ethernet interface and that maps to Redfish's LLDPEnabled on the Port schema? So this assumes a Port schema per PDI Ethernet Interface? 

https://github.com/openbmc/phosphor-dbus-interfaces/blob/af6b2cce7d97159360f292889f759e7739f6a0a4/yaml/xyz/openbmc_project/Network/EthernetInterface.interface.yaml#L114

I also see LLDPEnabled in network adapter, was there any discussion with Redfish about adding it to Ethernet?

Hi Gunnar

that's right LLDPEnabled on the Port schema mapped to EmitLLDP on the Ethernet interface. 

Here dmtf discussion https://github.com/DMTF/Redfish/issues/6093 on adding LLDP it to Ethernet. Implemented Port schema as per DMTF suggestion

Why in the backend (networkd / PDI) did we not implement a port on the Ethernet interface? And have EmitLLDP on that port interface ? This at a minimum  we have a pretty big assumption here that is not documented in the commit msg. I am struggling a bit with this assumption (assume 1 port per Ethernet interface but no Port interface). What if you had other properties in Port you wanted to model here?
Ideally this refactor would have been a separate commit, oh well. If you want to do that, that commit could go right now.
I think you are saying no problems here
